title: Implement the first lottery ingestion path

spec.expected_outcome: Confirm the migrated scope and acceptance criteria.
acceptance_criteria: One results source adapter is implemented.
Parsing tests cover malformed and duplicate draws.
Raw payloads are stored before normalization.
Draws are stored transactionally with a unique identity.
The first page shows the latest results and a simple statistic.
The path works without private credentials.
Build the first results and statistics page.
A fresh run ingests the source without duplicates.
The first page shows results and statistics.
The repository is tagged and backed up.
